tiles.name: Bald Eagle
tiles.notes: White head, yellow hooked bill, dark brown body

tiles.name: Osprey
tiles.notes: White face with dark eye stripe, lake behind

tiles.name: Red-tailed Hawk
tiles.notes: Rufous-brown head, streaked cream breast, red autumn leaves

tiles.name: Peregrine Falcon
tiles.notes: Slate-gray hood and 'moustache', barred cream breast

tiles.name: Barred Owl
tiles.notes: Round gray-brown face, dark eyes, no ear tufts, birches

tiles.name: Great Horned Owl
tiles.notes: Ear tufts, yellow eyes, mottled brown

tiles.name: American Crow
tiles.notes: Dark bird #1 (tile 07): slimmer, shorter bill; smooth throat; pine boughs framing both sides, no conifer trees

tiles.name: Common Raven
tiles.notes: Dark bird #2 (tile 08): heavier, deeper, more hooked bill; shaggy throat feathers; bulkier body; spruce trees on both sides

tiles.name: Blue Jay
tiles.notes: Blue crest, black necklace, orange leaves

tiles.name: Northern Cardinal
tiles.notes: All-red with black face mask, holly berries

tiles.name: American Robin
tiles.notes: Orange breast, dark head, white blossoms

tiles.name: Black-capped Chickadee
tiles.notes: Black cap and bib, white cheek, pinecone

tiles.name: Tufted Titmouse
tiles.notes: Gray crest, pale face, red berries

tiles.name: Pileated Woodpecker
tiles.notes: Red crest, black-and-white face, on a tree trunk

tiles.name: Belted Kingfisher
tiles.notes: Shaggy blue crest, blue-gray and rufous breast band

tiles.name: Great Blue Heron
tiles.notes: Long neck, dagger bill, marsh water

tiles.name: Wood Duck
tiles.notes: Iridescent green crest, red eye, chestnut breast

tiles.name: Wild Turkey
tiles.notes: Fanned tail, blue-and-red bare head

tiles.name: Canada Goose
tiles.notes: Black neck, white chinstrap, lake

tiles.name: Ruby-throated Hummingbird
tiles.notes: Hovering, red throat, red tubular flowers
